summary: setup's gather_subset limits which fact groups are collected (hardware, network, virtual, facter, etc.), supports ! exclusions, and !all,!min skips even the minimum facts.
questions: How do I speed up fact gathering by skipping hardware facts?
How do I collect only network facts?
How do I gather no facts at all with setup?
What's the difference between gather_subset and filter?

answer_card.title: Limit facts with gather_subset
answer_card.answer_md:
`gather_subset` (default `all`) picks fact groups: `hardware`, `network`, `virtual`, `facter`, `ohai`, `distribution`, `dns`, `mounts`, `selinux`, `service_mgr`, and many more.
- Prefix `!` to exclude: `!hardware,!network,!facter,!ohai`
- `!all` = only the minimum subset
- `!all,!min` = nothing; add specific subsets after it

`filter` only hides collected facts; `gather_subset` controls what is collected.
